name: ZeroB UV Lite
summary: The ZeroB UV Water Purifier is a compact, wall-mountable purifier designed for municipal and pre-treated water sources.
intro: ZeroB UV Water Purifier is an advanced UV-based water purification system designed for municipal and pre-treated water supplies. It uses an 11W UV lamp to effectively deactivate bacteria and viruses without adding chemicals, ensuring safe and healthy drinking water. Its intelligent UV Fail-Safe technology automatically stops water flow if the UV lamp is not functioning, guaranteeing that you receive only purified water. Featuring sediment and silver-impregnated activated carbon filtration, LED status indicators, and a compact wall-mount design, it delivers reliable purification at up to 1 litre per minute.
features: Advanced UV Purification effectively eliminates bacteria and viruses.
UV Fail-Safe Technology stops water flow if the UV lamp fails.
Chemical-Free Purification with no change in the natural taste of water.
5–10 Micron Sediment Filter removes dust, sand, and suspended particles.
Silver-Impregnated Activated Carbon Filter reduces chlorine, odour, and unpleasant taste.
Suitable for Municipal Water with TDS up to 500 ppm.
LED Indicators for Power, Purification Process, Ready Status, and UV Failure Alert.
Compact & Wall-Mountable design for modern kitchens.
